title: #36 Human Remains
text: Human remains are a fundamental part of the archaeological record, offering unique insights into the lives of individuals and populations in the past. Specialized methods of recovery and interpretation are required.

title: #39 Malaysia Tourism
text: Malaysia is launching its biggest ever tourism campaign in an effort to lure 20 million visitors here this year. Tourism is the Southeast Asian nation's second-largest source of foreign exchange after exports.

title: #40 Small Wars
text: In such an environment, warfare is no longer purely directed against the military potential of adversarial states. Both governmental and non-governmental actors prefer to use force in a way characterized as small wars.
